name: ccf
description: Claude Context First — a context-first, spec-driven, wave-parallel development workflow. Keeps CLAUDE.md/.claude specs continuously fresh and grounds every design decision in best practices fetched from Context7 and Microsoft Learn.

uiBand.title: CCF band above the prompt
uiBand.description: Show the active PLAN.md task, its lifecycle step and the next CCF command above the prompt.

uiBoard.title: CCF board pane
uiBoard.description: Register /ccf-board: PLAN.md tasks in todo, in-progress, in-review and done columns plus open PENDING.md risks; its buttons only prefill a command.

uiWaves.title: CCF wave map
uiWaves.description: On /ccf:cook, read scripts/plan-waves.mjs and show each worktree agent of the wave in a pane (/ccf-waves).

uiStatusLine.title: CCF status line
uiStatusLine.description: Show whether the spec is older than the code and the CLAUDE.md size from scripts/spec-budget.mjs.

remAi.title: AI-generated Rem lines
remAi.description: Let Claude Haiku 4.5 reword Rem's line after a notable event (a command's outcome, a test or build result, the end of a turn, a cook agent starting or finishing). The fixed line shows at once and stays whenever the call fails, times out after 8 seconds, or drops a fact. Each rewrite is one small Haiku call on your account.
